target: Amenaza superior natural de los Pedrales de Korven; gran criatura excavadora.
art_direction: Bestia excavadora grande y acorazada, adaptada a empujar bloques y desplazarse bajo piedra fracturada y tierra dura. La anatomía debe comunicar excavación y empuje, no golem ni criatura hecha de roca.
prompt: Create a wide wildlife scene in the Pedrales de Korven showing one complete adult Quebrarrocas emerging through fractured hard ground. A massive low natural burrowing beast with broad reinforced head and shoulders, powerful digging forelimbs, compact rear body and thick organic protective plates adapted to abrasion. Broken slabs around it have been physically displaced by its passage. Matte dusty organic surfaces in gray-brown mineral camouflage. It must feel like a living animal specialized for pushing stone, not stone itself. Korven remains dry, fractured and wind-worn.
negative_constraints: No golem, living rock, crystals, lava or magic
No metal armor or manufactured equipment
No giant mole, armadillo or rhinoceros literal copy
